entities.name: Aminomethyltransferase
observations: The 371-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry C6D8W9 from Pectobacterium carotovorum subsp. carotovorum.
Annotated EC 2.1.2.10; component of the glycine cleavage system; Pfam domains GCV_T and GCV_T_C are present.
Catalyzes transfer of the glycine-derived aminomethyl group to tetrahydrofolate using a lipoylated lysine-bearing H protein intermediate.

entities.name: Glycine cleavage aminomethyl transfer
observations: This is the aminomethyltransferase step of glycine degradation, EC 2.1.2.10; Rhea RHEA:16945.

entities.name: GCV_T
observations: Pfam GCV_T domain occurs at residues 7–263 in the query sequence.

entities.name: GCV_T_C
observations: Pfam GCV_T_C domain occurs at residues 285–362 in the query sequence.
